statements:
CREATE TABLE admin_users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	normalized_username VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	password_changed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_admin_users_singleton_id CHECK (id = 1), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_admin_users_normalized_username UNIQUE (normalized_username)
)

CREATE TABLE arr_settings (
	service VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	server_url VARCHAR, 
	api_key TEXT, 
	last_checked_at DATETIME, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (service)
)

CREATE TABLE auth_sessions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	admin_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_digest TEXT NOT NULL, 
	csrf_token_digest TEXT NOT NULL, 
	csrf_token_ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_used_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	absolute_expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	idle_expires_at DATETIME, 
	remember_me BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(admin_user_id) REFERENCES admin_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (token_digest)
)

CREATE TABLE auth_settings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	authentication_required VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_auth_settings_singleton_id CHECK (id = 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_auth_settings_method CHECK (method IN ('forms', 'external')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_auth_settings_required_mode CHECK (authentication_required IN ('enabled', 'disabled_for_local_addresses'))
)

CREATE TABLE credits_detection_runs (
	scan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	configuration_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	detector_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	cache_key VARCHAR, 
	result_json TEXT, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scan_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_credits_detection_configuration CHECK (length(configuration_json) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_credits_detection_version CHECK (length(detector_version) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_credits_detection_cache CHECK (cache_key IS NULL OR length(cache_key) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_credits_detection_result CHECK (result_json IS NULL OR length(result_json) > 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_id) REFERENCES scans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE filter_selection_rules (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	settings_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	disposition VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	evidence_source VARCHAR, 
	category VARCHAR(18), 
	subcategory VARCHAR, 
	label_contains VARCHAR, 
	severity VARCHAR(6), 
	mcf_channel VARCHAR(5), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_filter_rules_position UNIQUE (settings_id, position), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_filter_rules_position CHECK (position >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_filter_rules_disposition CHECK (disposition IN ('allow', 'deny')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_filter_rules_source CHECK (evidence_source IS NULL OR evidence_source IN ('audio', 'visual')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_filter_rules_channel CHECK (mcf_channel IS NULL OR mcf_channel IN ('both', 'video', 'audio')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_filter_rules_subcategory_family CHECK (subcategory IS NULL OR (category IS NOT NULL AND ((category = 'commercial_content' AND subcategory IN ('commercial', 'advertBreak', 'consumerism', 'productPlacement')) OR (category = 'discrimination' AND subcategory IN ('discrimination', 'adultism', 'antisemitism', 'genderism', 'homophobia', 'misandry', 'misogyny', 'racism', 'sexism', 'supremacism', 'transphobia', 'xenophobia')) OR (category = 'dispensable_scenes' AND subcategory IN ('dispensable', 'idiocy', 'tedious')) OR (category = 'drugs' AND subcategory IN ('drugs', 'alcohol', 'antipsychotics', 'cigarettes', 'depressants', 'gambling', 'hallucinogens', 'stimulants')) OR (category = 'fear' AND subcategory IN ('fear', 'accident', 'acrophobia', 'aliens', 'arachnophobia', 'astraphobia', 'aviophobia', 'chemophobia', 'claustrophobia', 'coulrophobia', 'cynophobia', 'death', 'dentophobia', 'emetophobia', 'enochlophobia', 'explosion', 'fire', 'gerascophobia', 'ghosts', 'grave', 'hemophobia', 'hylophobia', 'melissophobia', 'misophonia', 'musophobia', 'mysophobia', 'nosocomephobia', 'nyctophobia', 'siderodromophobia', 'thalassophobia', 'vampires')) OR (category = 'language' AND subcategory IN ('language', 'blasphemy', 'nameCalling', 'sexualDialogue', 'swearing', 'vulgarity')) OR (category = 'nudity' AND subcategory IN ('nudity', 'bareButtocks', 'exposedGenitalia', 'fullNudity', 'toplessness')) OR (category = 'sex' AND subcategory IN ('sex', 'adultery', 'analSex', 'coitus', 'kissing', 'masturbation', 'objectification', 'oralSex', 'premaritalSex', 'promiscuity', 'prostitution')) OR (category = 'violence' AND subcategory IN ('violence', 'choking', 'crueltyToAnimals', 'culturalViolence', 'desecration', 'emotionalViolence', 'kicking', 'massacre', 'murder', 'punching', 'rape', 'slapping', 'slavery', 'stabbing', 'torture', 'warfare', 'weapons'))))), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_filter_rules_has_matcher CHECK (evidence_source IS NOT NULL OR category IS NOT NULL OR subcategory IS NOT NULL OR label_contains IS NOT NULL OR severity IS NOT NULL OR mcf_channel IS NOT NULL), 
	FOREIGN KEY(settings_id) REFERENCES filter_settings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT mcfcategoryfamily CHECK (category IN ('commercial_content', 'discrimination', 'dispensable_scenes', 'drugs', 'fear', 'language', 'nudity', 'sex', 'violence')), 
	CONSTRAINT severity CHECK (severity IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')), 
	CONSTRAINT mcfchannel CHECK (mcf_channel IN ('both', 'video', 'audio'))
)

CREATE TABLE filter_settings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_filter_settings_singleton_id CHECK (id = 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_filter_settings_revision CHECK (revision >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE jellyfin_settings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	server_url VARCHAR, 
	api_key TEXT, 
	last_checked_at DATETIME, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE mcf_severity_defaults (
	settings_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	subcategory VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (settings_id, subcategory), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_mcf_severity_position UNIQUE (settings_id, position), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_mcf_severity_subcategory UNIQUE (settings_id, subcategory), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_mcf_severity_position CHECK (position >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(settings_id) REFERENCES filter_settings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT severity CHECK (severity IN ('low', 'medium', 'high'))
)

CREATE TABLE media_item_export_scans (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	media_item_export_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (media_item_export_id, scan_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_export_scans_role CHECK (role IN ('audio', 'video', 'both')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(media_item_export_id) REFERENCES media_item_exports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_id) REFERENCES scans (id)
)

CREATE TABLE media_item_exports (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	media_item_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	media_source_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	format VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, 
	exported_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	review_id VARCHAR, 
	exported_format_revision INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (media_item_id, media_source_id, format), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_media_item_exports_format CHECK (format IN ('edl', 'mcf')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_media_item_exports_review_provenance CHECK ((review_id IS NULL AND exported_format_revision IS NULL) OR (review_id IS NOT NULL AND exported_format_revision IS NOT NULL AND exported_format_revision >= 0)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(media_item_id) REFERENCES media_items (id), 
	CONSTRAINT exportformat CHECK (format IN ('edl', 'mcf')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(review_id) REFERENCES saved_reviews (id)
)

CREATE TABLE media_items (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	server_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	jellyfin_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	library_id VARCHAR, 
	item_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	path VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (server_id, jellyfin_id)
)

CREATE TABLE path_mappings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	remote_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	local_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_accepted_credits (
	review_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_finding_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	candidate_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	detected_boundary_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	accepted_boundary_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR(11) NOT NULL, 
	accepted_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (review_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_review_accepted_credits_finding_scan FOREIGN KEY(source_finding_id, scan_id) REFERENCES scan_findings (id, scan_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_accepted_credits_candidate CHECK (length(candidate_id) > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_accepted_credits_detected_boundary CHECK (detected_boundary_seconds >= 0 AND detected_boundary_seconds < 1e308), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_accepted_credits_accepted_boundary CHECK (accepted_boundary_seconds >= 0 AND accepted_boundary_seconds < 1e308), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_accepted_credits_confidence CHECK (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_accepted_credits_method CHECK (method IN ('chapters', 'visual_text', 'hybrid', 'hybrid_qwen')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(review_id) REFERENCES saved_reviews (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT creditsdetectionmethod CHECK (method IN ('chapters', 'visual_text', 'hybrid', 'hybrid_qwen'))
)

CREATE TABLE review_filters (
	review_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_scan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_finding_id INTEGER, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(18), 
	subcategory VARCHAR, 
	severity VARCHAR(6), 
	mcf_channel VARCHAR(5), 
	mcf_comment TEXT, 
	label VARCHAR, 
	details TEXT, 
	group_key VARCHAR, 
	start_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	end_seconds FLOAT, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	edit_action VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	selected BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (review_id, id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_review_filters_finding UNIQUE (review_id, source_finding_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_review_filters_position UNIQUE (review_id, position), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_review_filters_source_finding_scan FOREIGN KEY(source_finding_id, source_scan_id) REFERENCES scan_findings (id, scan_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_filters_position CHECK (position >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_filters_source CHECK (source IN ('audio', 'visual')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_filters_action CHECK (edit_action IN ('mute', 'skip')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_filters_start CHECK (start_seconds >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_filters_end CHECK (end_seconds IS NULL OR end_seconds > start_seconds), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_filters_confidence CHECK (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_filters_classification_pair CHECK ((category IS NULL AND subcategory IS NULL) OR (category IS NOT NULL AND subcategory IS NOT NULL AND ((category = 'commercial_content' AND subcategory IN ('commercial', 'advertBreak', 'consumerism', 'productPlacement')) OR (category = 'discrimination' AND subcategory IN ('discrimination', 'adultism', 'antisemitism', 'genderism', 'homophobia', 'misandry', 'misogyny', 'racism', 'sexism', 'supremacism', 'transphobia', 'xenophobia')) OR (category = 'dispensable_scenes' AND subcategory IN ('dispensable', 'idiocy', 'tedious')) OR (category = 'drugs' AND subcategory IN ('drugs', 'alcohol', 'antipsychotics', 'cigarettes', 'depressants', 'gambling', 'hallucinogens', 'stimulants')) OR (category = 'fear' AND subcategory IN ('fear', 'accident', 'acrophobia', 'aliens', 'arachnophobia', 'astraphobia', 'aviophobia', 'chemophobia', 'claustrophobia', 'coulrophobia', 'cynophobia', 'death', 'dentophobia', 'emetophobia', 'enochlophobia', 'explosion', 'fire', 'gerascophobia', 'ghosts', 'grave', 'hemophobia', 'hylophobia', 'melissophobia', 'misophonia', 'musophobia', 'mysophobia', 'nosocomephobia', 'nyctophobia', 'siderodromophobia', 'thalassophobia', 'vampires')) OR (category = 'language' AND subcategory IN ('language', 'blasphemy', 'nameCalling', 'sexualDialogue', 'swearing', 'vulgarity')) OR (category = 'nudity' AND subcategory IN ('nudity', 'bareButtocks', 'exposedGenitalia', 'fullNudity', 'toplessness')) OR (category = 'sex' AND subcategory IN ('sex', 'adultery', 'analSex', 'coitus', 'kissing', 'masturbation', 'objectification', 'oralSex', 'premaritalSex', 'promiscuity', 'prostitution')) OR (category = 'violence' AND subcategory IN ('violence', 'choking', 'crueltyToAnimals', 'culturalViolence', 'desecration', 'emotionalViolence', 'kicking', 'massacre', 'murder', 'punching', 'rape', 'slapping', 'slavery', 'stabbing', 'torture', 'warfare', 'weapons'))))), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_filters_mcf_channel CHECK (mcf_channel IS NULL OR mcf_channel IN ('both', 'video', 'audio')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_filters_mcf_comment CHECK (mcf_comment IS NULL OR (length(mcf_comment) > 0 AND instr(mcf_comment, char(10)) = 0 AND instr(mcf_comment, char(13)) = 0 AND instr(mcf_comment, '-->') = 0)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(review_id) REFERENCES saved_reviews (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_scan_id) REFERENCES scans (id), 
	CONSTRAINT mcfcategoryfamily CHECK (category IN ('commercial_content', 'discrimination', 'dispensable_scenes', 'drugs', 'fear', 'language', 'nudity', 'sex', 'violence')), 
	CONSTRAINT severity CHECK (severity IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')), 
	CONSTRAINT mcfchannel CHECK (mcf_channel IN ('both', 'video', 'audio'))
)

CREATE TABLE review_mcf_documents (
	review_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR, 
	year INTEGER, 
	work_type VARCHAR(7), 
	season INTEGER, 
	episode INTEGER, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	imdb_url TEXT, 
	release VARCHAR, 
	comment TEXT, 
	material_start_seconds FLOAT, 
	material_end_seconds FLOAT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (review_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_mcf_year CHECK (year IS NULL OR year >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_mcf_season CHECK (season IS NULL OR season > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_mcf_episode CHECK (episode IS NULL OR episode > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_mcf_start CHECK (material_start_seconds IS NULL OR material_start_seconds >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_mcf_positive_end CHECK (material_end_seconds IS NULL OR material_end_seconds > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_mcf_end CHECK (material_start_seconds IS NULL OR material_end_seconds IS NULL OR material_end_seconds > material_start_seconds), 
	FOREIGN KEY(review_id) REFERENCES saved_reviews (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT mcfworktype CHECK (work_type IN ('movie', 'series', 'episode'))
)

CREATE TABLE review_scan_memberships (
	review_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	position INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (review_id, scan_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_review_memberships_position UNIQUE (review_id, position), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_memberships_role CHECK (role IN ('audio', 'video', 'both')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_memberships_position CHECK (position >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(review_id) REFERENCES saved_reviews (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_id) REFERENCES scans (id)
)

CREATE TABLE review_synchronizations (
	review_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	start_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	end_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	end_mode VARCHAR(14) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (review_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_synchronization_start CHECK (start_seconds >= 0 AND start_seconds < 1e308), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_synchronization_end CHECK (end_seconds > start_seconds AND end_seconds < 1e308), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_review_synchronization_end_mode CHECK (end_mode IN ('before_credits', 'file_end')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(review_id) REFERENCES saved_reviews (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT synchronizationendmode CHECK (end_mode IN ('before_credits', 'file_end'))
)

CREATE TABLE saved_reviews (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	media_item_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	media_source_id VARCHAR DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	content_revision INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	edl_content_revision INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	mcf_content_revision INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_saved_reviews_name CHECK (length(name) >= 1 AND length(name) <= 100 AND name = trim(name, '	
                   　') AND instr(name, char(0)) = 0 AND NOT (name GLOB '*[--]*')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_saved_reviews_revision CHECK (revision >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_saved_reviews_content_revision CHECK (content_revision >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_saved_reviews_edl_revision CHECK (edl_content_revision >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_saved_reviews_mcf_revision CHECK (mcf_content_revision >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(media_item_id) REFERENCES media_items (id)
)

CREATE TABLE scan_findings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(18), 
	subcategory VARCHAR, 
	severity VARCHAR(6), 
	mcf_channel VARCHAR(5), 
	mcf_comment TEXT, 
	start_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	end_seconds FLOAT, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR, 
	details TEXT, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	selected BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	edit_action VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	group_key VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_scan_findings_id_scan UNIQUE (id, scan_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scan_findings_classification_pair CHECK ((category IS NULL AND subcategory IS NULL) OR (category IS NOT NULL AND subcategory IS NOT NULL AND ((category = 'commercial_content' AND subcategory IN ('commercial', 'advertBreak', 'consumerism', 'productPlacement')) OR (category = 'discrimination' AND subcategory IN ('discrimination', 'adultism', 'antisemitism', 'genderism', 'homophobia', 'misandry', 'misogyny', 'racism', 'sexism', 'supremacism', 'transphobia', 'xenophobia')) OR (category = 'dispensable_scenes' AND subcategory IN ('dispensable', 'idiocy', 'tedious')) OR (category = 'drugs' AND subcategory IN ('drugs', 'alcohol', 'antipsychotics', 'cigarettes', 'depressants', 'gambling', 'hallucinogens', 'stimulants')) OR (category = 'fear' AND subcategory IN ('fear', 'accident', 'acrophobia', 'aliens', 'arachnophobia', 'astraphobia', 'aviophobia', 'chemophobia', 'claustrophobia', 'coulrophobia', 'cynophobia', 'death', 'dentophobia', 'emetophobia', 'enochlophobia', 'explosion', 'fire', 'gerascophobia', 'ghosts', 'grave', 'hemophobia', 'hylophobia', 'melissophobia', 'misophonia', 'musophobia', 'mysophobia', 'nosocomephobia', 'nyctophobia', 'siderodromophobia', 'thalassophobia', 'vampires')) OR (category = 'language' AND subcategory IN ('language', 'blasphemy', 'nameCalling', 'sexualDialogue', 'swearing', 'vulgarity')) OR (category = 'nudity' AND subcategory IN ('nudity', 'bareButtocks', 'exposedGenitalia', 'fullNudity', 'toplessness')) OR (category = 'sex' AND subcategory IN ('sex', 'adultery', 'analSex', 'coitus', 'kissing', 'masturbation', 'objectification', 'oralSex', 'premaritalSex', 'promiscuity', 'prostitution')) OR (category = 'violence' AND subcategory IN ('violence', 'choking', 'crueltyToAnimals', 'culturalViolence', 'desecration', 'emotionalViolence', 'kicking', 'massacre', 'murder', 'punching', 'rape', 'slapping', 'slavery', 'stabbing', 'torture', 'warfare', 'weapons'))))), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scan_findings_mcf_channel CHECK (mcf_channel IS NULL OR mcf_channel IN ('both', 'video', 'audio')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scan_findings_mcf_comment CHECK (mcf_comment IS NULL OR (length(mcf_comment) > 0 AND instr(mcf_comment, char(10)) = 0 AND instr(mcf_comment, char(13)) = 0 AND instr(mcf_comment, '-->') = 0)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_id) REFERENCES scans (id), 
	CONSTRAINT mcfcategoryfamily CHECK (category IN ('commercial_content', 'discrimination', 'dispensable_scenes', 'drugs', 'fear', 'language', 'nudity', 'sex', 'violence')), 
	CONSTRAINT severity CHECK (severity IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')), 
	CONSTRAINT mcfchannel CHECK (mcf_channel IN ('both', 'video', 'audio'))
)

CREATE TABLE scan_mcf_documents (
	scan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_version VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR, 
	year INTEGER, 
	work_type VARCHAR(7), 
	season INTEGER, 
	episode INTEGER, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	imdb_url TEXT, 
	release VARCHAR, 
	comment TEXT, 
	material_start_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	material_end_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scan_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scan_mcf_year CHECK (year IS NULL OR year >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scan_mcf_season CHECK (season IS NULL OR season > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scan_mcf_episode CHECK (episode IS NULL OR episode > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scan_mcf_start CHECK (material_start_seconds >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scan_mcf_end CHECK (material_end_seconds > material_start_seconds), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_id) REFERENCES scans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT mcfsourceversion CHECK (source_version IN ('1.0.0', '1.1.0')), 
	CONSTRAINT mcfworktype CHECK (work_type IN ('movie', 'series', 'episode'))
)

CREATE TABLE scan_media_item_associations (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	media_item_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (scan_id, media_item_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_id) REFERENCES scans (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(media_item_id) REFERENCES media_items (id)
)

CREATE TABLE scan_queue (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scan_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (scan_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scan_id) REFERENCES scans (id)
)

CREATE TABLE scans (
	id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	media_item_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scan_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR, 
	origin VARCHAR DEFAULT 'generated' NOT NULL, 
	import_source_name VARCHAR, 
	imported_at DATETIME, 
	scan_mode VARCHAR(17) DEFAULT 'content' NOT NULL, 
	source_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	media_source_id VARCHAR, 
	media_source_name VARCHAR, 
	resolved_local_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	video_hash VARCHAR, 
	scene_name VARCHAR, 
	release_group VARCHAR, 
	media_format VARCHAR, 
	media_provider_id VARCHAR, 
	duration_seconds FLOAT, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	scan_audio BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	audio_model VARCHAR, 
	audio_filter VARCHAR, 
	scan_video BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	video_model VARCHAR, 
	frame_interval FLOAT, 
	speed_up BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	qwen_model VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	qwen_summaries_per_segment INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	qwen_segment_join_gap_seconds FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	selection_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	progress_percent FLOAT, 
	progress_stage VARCHAR, 
	progress_message VARCHAR, 
	worker_pid INTEGER, 
	worker_pgid INTEGER, 
	worker_token VARCHAR, 
	worker_started_at DATETIME, 
	worker_heartbeat_at DATETIME, 
	visual_checkpoint_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	audio_extraction_checkpoint_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	audio_checkpoint_complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	checkpoint_stage VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	checkpoint_state TEXT NOT NULL, 
	checkpoint_updated_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (media_item_id, scan_number), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scans_name CHECK (name IS NULL OR length(name) >= 1 AND length(name) <= 100 AND name = trim(name, '	
                   　') AND instr(name, char(0)) = 0 AND NOT (name GLOB '*[--]*')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scans_origin CHECK (origin IN ('generated', 'manual', 'imported')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_scans_mode CHECK (scan_mode IN ('content', 'credits_detection')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(media_item_id) REFERENCES media_items (id), 
	CONSTRAINT scanmode CHECK (scan_mode IN ('content', 'credits_detection'))
)
